key_result: Pooled and cross-sectional IC were near zero
decision: Retire signal_score as a trading rank; retain as research field

decision: Keep trigger framing; do not tune from one event

key_result: Theoretical ACTION mean was positive, but sample and execution contract were weak
decision: Continue only with longer history and executable-price evaluation

primary_hypothesis: Event-level ML can filter weak rule signals without replacing rules
key_result: Main AUC/PR-AUC and calibration were weak; all major tasks had small-sample warnings
decision: Keep shadow-only; do not gate production ACTION

key_result: Standardized event units and theoretical/live/manual return layers
decision: Treat as integration phase, not an Alpha version

primary_hypothesis: A canonical PIT panel can support chronological validation
evidence_scope: About 200 target dates; 180-day common slice used later
key_result: Enabled walk-forward research but exposed future-selected-universe and microstructure gaps

primary_hypothesis: Bond type, friction, qIV/MC and LSMC can select intraday versus daily holding
key_result: Intraday -4.327%; daily LSMC -9.722%; hybrid -8.171% under the stated 10bps/5x fee stress
decision: Downgrade qIV/MC to diagnostics and LSMC away from entry

primary_hypothesis: Stock shocks may leave an actionable CB response in lag1-lag3
evidence_scope: 180 days; 170 bonds; four 45-day windows; 138 repair events
key_result: Gross mean 0.0020%; realistic net -0.0999%; lag0 dominated and 2-bar delay turned gross negative
decision: No tradable 5-minute linkage Alpha; daily RV remains only a biased low-priority hypothesis
